Case reference: 2008019999.CaseDesc: Patrick O’Connell has been missing since July 4, 2008. He was last seen by a friend and roommate. Patrick suffers from a mental health disorder, and has challenges related to substance use. He is reported to have been despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2013000050.CaseDesc: William 'Billy' Weinbender has been missing since approximately 7:30pm on May 6th, 1994 from Winnipeg. At the time he went missing he was living in an apartment building in the North End of the city. William "Billy" was last seen in the McPhillips Street and Leila Avenue area of Winnipeg.

Case reference: 2019071976.CaseDesc: In September of 2012, Donald Watson was last seen by his mother, and his family has had no contact with him since this time. Donald is transient in nature and usually travels on foot as transportation. Canada Border Services Agency’s last documentation of Donald was in 2013 when he entered Laredo, Texas in the United States from Mexico as a pedestrian.

Case reference: 2014005513.CaseDesc: Jayson Nakas was reported missing to the RCMP in Drayton Valley, Alberta, on June 30, 1995. Jayson fell off an inner tube in the North Saskatchewan River. His friends saw him go under the water, but did not see him come back up.  They were the last people to see him that day.

Case reference: 2012020107.CaseDesc: Isabelle Bourgeot, 32, was seen for the last time on November 1st, 1985 in the La Cité-Limoilou district in Quebec City, Quebec. At the time of her disappearance Isabelle wasn’t carrying any identification papers. It should be noted that she suffers from amnesia.

Case reference: 2014002145.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1975, William Garson, his father, his brother and a friend set out for a hunt in Moose Lake, Manitoba. On September 14, other hunters found gas cans and a thermos with the Garson name on it. These hunters reported their findings to the police.  A search was initiated and police found a boat sitting upright on the bottom of the lake. The depth of the lake around the boat was only 8 to 10 feet. Police believe the men encountered extremely rough water while crossing Moose Lake. The motors were found to be in forward gear. There was no flotation gear in the boat and it was heavily loaded with camping and hunting equipment. All bodies recovered except William, presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2014005333.CaseDesc: Jack Nutter attended a medical appointment in Moncton, New Brunswick, in June 2007, later leaving and has not been seen since. Police have not been able to confirm any sightings of Jack since his appointment. Jack's family is concerned for his wellbeing.

Case reference: 2014004671.CaseDesc: Murphy Quill was last seen in mid-July 2005. Concerns have been raised by his family and friends regarding his well-being, as it is not typical for him to be out of contact for such an extended period. Although he does not have a fixed address, Murphy is known to frequent the Main Street strip and the area near 75 Martha Street in Winnipeg, Manitoba.

Case reference: 2017073542.CaseDesc: On November 4, 2016, an unidentified man was discovered in Lake Ontario in St. Catharines, Ontario. Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts he was of East Asian Ancestry.

Case reference: 2012020113.CaseDesc: On September 11, 2004, Sylvie Menard was reported missing in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. Sylvie was last seen at approximately 1:00 p.m. in a licensed establishment located at the intersection of 3rd Row and Highway 359 (Main Street) in Saint-Luc-de-Vincennes, Quebec.

Case reference: 2012030001.CaseDesc: In April 2011, both parents took their son, Aleksander to visit the mother's family in Poland. The father came back to Canada on his own on May 13, 2011. The mother, Elzbieta Nowacki and child did not return to Canada.

Case reference: 2006004799.CaseDesc: Ralph Monague and Curtis Smith were passengers on the Christian Island Ferry travelling between Cedar Point and Christian Island on December 22, 1985, when they fell over board in stormy conditions.

Case reference: 2014002341.CaseDesc: On June 23, 1979, Terrence Henderson was last seen canoeing on Lac St. Anne in Ross Haven, Alberta.

Case reference: 2015056222.CaseDesc: On October 15, 2015, Robert Luery was last seen on Lake Simcoe where he was sailing in strong winds.  His sail boat was located floating around the lake unoccupied.  An extensive search of the lake was completed and Robert was not located.

Case reference: 2014004721.CaseDesc: Belinda Gertrude Williams was last seen by her sister and father in July 1976, in Vancouver, British Columbia. Belinda was not reported missing until February 2004 to the Stl'Atl'lmx Tribal Police in Mt. Currie, British Columbia.  Stl'Atl'lmx Tribal Police determined that Belinda was last seen by witnesses in Mission, British Columbia.

Scar: Eyes, Below eye, unknown which eye

Case reference: 2014002675.CaseDesc: Richard Monroe was last seen on October 2nd, 2001 by the owners of Serge's Restaurant on Elgin Street in the city of Greater Sudbury. Richard is believed to have suffered from dementia. He spent most of his time in Thessalon, Sault Ste. Marie, Dunn's Valley, Sudbury and British Columbia.

Case reference: 2015059939.CaseDesc: On October 20, 1973, the remains of a male were recovered from the water near the Fleet Street Pumping Station, Ottawa. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being between 170-180lbs, however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.  It is estimated that he had been in the water between 2 and 3 months.

Case reference: 2021000934.CaseDesc: On January 25, 2002, Vincent Lamouris was seen for the last time near the American Falls in Niagara Falls, New York. During the time of his disappearance, Vincent was despondent.

Shoes: Black, Dress shoes; brand: Mephisto; with a buckle on the side
Sweater: Wool, Black, Long sleeves; Ralph Lauren logo on the chest
Watch: White, Wrist watch; brand: Rodania; with a black leather strap

Case reference: 2014004725.CaseDesc: Jack Ford was last seen on September 20, 1991, when he went hunting in a region north of Cold Lake in Alberta. His abandoned vehicle was discovered by hunters on a cut line near Cold Lake on either September 21 or 28, 1991. On October 16, 1991, Jack's son reported him missing.

Case reference: 2024041945.CaseDesc: Patrick Copelin was seen on March 11, 2011, leaving his residence in Niagara Falls, New York, USA.  Shortly after, he was seen jumping into Niagara Falls at Prospect Point.  At the time of his disappearance, Patrick was feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2006007099.CaseDesc: On July 21, 1995, Erwyn Lippett and his friend, Kirk Weidmann, left the Brucedale conservation area to go for a canoe ride on Lake Huron, near Port Elgin, Ontario. Two life-jackets and two paddles were recovered in the water. Neither man has been seen since.

Mark: Forehead, Large mole on forehead at receding hairline

Tattoo: Right Arm, Boot Hill with cross
Chest, clouds with name Simon and Victoria

Case reference: 2008023599.CaseDesc: On March 26, 1993, family reported Gordon Andrew Cameron as missing. The last reported sighting of Gordon was on February 28 at Lino's Restaurant on Princess Street in Kingston, Ontario. There have been no further sightings or contact with him since then.  At the time of his disappearance, he was a self-employed auto-body repairman. His shop was located at the intersection of Brule Road and Highway 2 in Kingston. There is a suspicion of foul play in relation to his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014006505.CaseDesc: On March 10, 2014, Sandra Mensah was seen for the last time in the Cartierville district of Montreal, Quebec. Her boyfriend came to pick her up at her home during the evening. Sandra has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2016068414.CaseDesc: On August 30, 1965, this unidentified male was found on the shore of Lake Ontario just east of the harbour pier in Oshawa. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 160 lbs, however, this may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His appendix was present and he was not circumcised.

Teeth: Decayed teeth; gold inlay and prosthesis in his upper dentition; lower dentition had an amalgam filling
Shoes: Leather, Veritough, one left shoe; size 7
Scar: Right Upper Arm, circular puckered scar 1" in diameter on the anterior right underarm

Case reference: 2014003868.CaseDesc: On Sunday April 18, 1976, Gary Michael Pinkney left his home in Fort Churchill, Manitoba, at around midday, riding his snowmobile. His destination was Hudson Bay, and he had planned to return home that same evening. The following day, April 19, at approximately 8:00 am, Helen Pinkney contacted the Churchill RCMP detachment to report that her husband had not yet returned home. Extensive land and air searches of the area were conducted over several days, but were unsuccessful. Given his intended route, it is presumed that Gary drowned, and his remains have not been located.

Boots: Leather, Beige, Felt-lined with white fur trim
Jewelry: Gold, Gold ring with black stone
Scar: 4 inch scar on either left or right leg
Tattoo: Right Forearm, Text on a scroll "Gary"
Right Forearm, Eagle with rising sun

Case reference: 2006011899.CaseDesc: Eric McKay was last seen outside "Clarkes Tavern" in Sioux Lookout, Ontario on December 22, 1987.

Case reference: 2014045101.CaseDesc: The partial remains of an older adult female were found near Chasm, British Colombia in 2010. She had no teeth in her lower jaw and had likely gone missing many years earlier.

Case reference: 2014004556.CaseDesc: On January 18, 1981, at approximately 12:00pm, Donna Bester was last seen by her boyfriend in Toronto, Ontario. During the time of her disappearance, Donna was supposed to check into the North York General Hospital, but did not arrive and may have been despondent.

Case reference: 2006005399.CaseDesc: In October 1956, Charles Ombash and his brother Tom Ombash left the Pelican Falls Residential School near Sioux Lookout, Ontario. Their plan was to canoe back to Cat Lake, or to take the train to Savant Lake, hitchhike to Pickle Lake and then canoe on to Cat Lake. The family has not had any contact with them since that time.

Case reference: 2018071052.CaseDesc: On July 11, 1998, the remains of a male individual were discovered on Sulphur Mountain in Banff National Park. There is dental work present, including multiple fillings. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 6 months and 5 years.

Case reference: 2014004917.CaseDesc: Robert Rudish and Lee Vrba arrived in Island Lake Manitoba on June 11, 1972, to fish. On June 17, RCMP received a report that a canoe was found overturned in the water. The canoe was soon identified as belonging to Lee. RCMP Investigators surmised the men went missing on either the Thursday or the Friday. The weather on both days was extreme, with high winds gusting to 30 mph, which caused the lake to be quite rough. Neither of the two men have been located and it is presumed both drowned.

Tattoo: tattoo on right or left forearm

Case reference: 2014005935.CaseDesc: On December 4, 2012, Lucien Bélanger left his residence near the Saint-François River in Drummondville, Quebec. Lucien was despondent at the time of the disappearance.

Case reference: 2014003528.CaseDesc: Kate Huyghe was last seen in Killam, Alberta on February 21, 1976.

Boots: Leather, Black, winter boot with suede fur tops
Jewelry: Metal, Gold, family ring with colored stone

Case reference: 2023013736.CaseDesc: On July 13, 2022, Magdalene Oerlemans was seen for the last time in Edmonton, Alberta. At the time of her disappearance, Magdalene was leading a high-risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2014001690.CaseDesc: On December 7, 1971, James MacDonald departed Thompson, Manitoba in his "Money Mark 21" aircraft bound for Winnipeg. James never arrived. Despite intensive air search neither James nor his aircraft have been located.

Jewelry: Metal, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Engineering ring
Metal, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Calendar watch

Case reference: 2012020654.CaseDesc: On May 12, 1997, Darold Kishayinew was last seen at a relative’s house in Regina, Saskatchewan.

Case reference: 2014001191.CaseDesc: On April 22, 2010, the body of an unidentified man was found in the Richelieu River in Saint-Mathias-sur-Richelieu, Quebec. In his possession were a "Hipstreet" brand MP3 player and headphones. The images shown are facial approximation portraits of this unidentified man created by the Sûreté du Québec.

Case reference: 2014006077.CaseDesc: Schuyler Bierkos was last seen by his roommate at his home in Calgary, Alberta on February 24, 2013. The reason for his disapearance is unknown.

Hair: Blonde, Other, Usually has a beard
Scar: Head, Severe acne and scars on face

Case reference: 2014001798.CaseDesc: On March 3, 1987, Nancy Dumas was reported missing. She was last seen by her daughter. Nancy had said that she was going to find her friends, and left her daughter's residence. She has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005815.CaseDesc: On June 18, 2012, at 4:30 p.m., the Regina Police Service received a call from Floyd Kakakaway. He told them that his brother Frederick (Fred) Kakakaway was missing. Floyd stated that he had last seen Fred early on June 14, 2012, at 6 a.m. Fred had told Floyd that he was heading to the Regent Park Safeway to look for recyclable cans. He has so far failed to return home and there has been no trace of him since that time. Fred is diabetic.

Deformity: Right Leg, Walks with a slight limp
Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, A cross, forks and a heart
Left Upper Arm, Heart and ribbon with text "FRED"

Case reference: 2006026899.CaseDesc: Dr. Stanley Kemp left his residence in Sturgeon Falls, Ontario, on May 19, 1960, to go fishing. On May 20, 1960, he failed to return home and was reported missing. On May 21, 1960, his vehicle was found parked at Finlayson Lake, McLaren Township, District of Nipissing, Ontario. His canoe and personal belongings were located on the lake.

Case reference: 2008000499.CaseDesc: Kimberley Ann Amero was last seen at her residence in Saint John, New Brunswick on September 3, 1985. There has been no contact with family or friends since.

Case reference: 2010001399.CaseDesc: On October 28, 2009, Trevor Andrews was seen for the last time when he left a friend's house in a residential area of London, Ontario, intending to catch a bus to go home. He never returned home to his father's apartment. It cannot be confirmed that he got on the bus. Trevor is known to be very sociable. He would be noticed because of his energetic behaviour. His absence and not calling home is out of character.

Case reference: 2010003599.CaseDesc: Alexander McAuley was reported missing by family members on April 23, 2010, after not having any contact with him since 2002. Alexander was known to lead a high risk lifestyle and may have met with foul play.

Case reference: 2006025399.CaseDesc: Walter Mesem was last seen on April 25, 1982, driving his vehicle in the Eldorado area. An extensive search of the area has failed to locate him.

Coat: Green, Hand knitted cuffs, zippered front

Case reference: 2006017899.CaseDesc: On September 8, 1973, John Begolo was last seen in Eganville, Ontario.  John indicated that he was planning to return to St. Catherine's, Ontario, by bus.  John has not been seen or heard from since.

Tattoo: Right Forearm, Canadian Flag and Maple Leaf
Left Forearm, Nude woman entwined by snake

Case reference: 2013000063.CaseDesc: Pierre-Paul Proulx was last seen on August 8, 2002 when he left his apartment located in the Mont-Royal district of Montreal, in Quebec. Pierre-Paul was last seen leaving in his vehicle after receiving a phone call. He was later reported missing to the police on August 21, 2002. There has been no news of his whereabouts since that time.

Pierce: Ears, Gold loop in left ear

Case reference: 2014005807.CaseDesc: On May 30, 2012, Marc St-Laurent was seen for the last time on a bench outside the grocery store at Place Quévillon in Lebel-sur-Quévillon, Quebec. His pick-up, a white 1992 GMC Sierra, was located on 26 July 2012, in a federated snowmobile trail, approximately three kilometres from Lebel-sur-Quévillon.

Case reference: 2014003388.CaseDesc: Janet Henry was a resident of Vancouver's downtown east side; she struggled with mental health and was engaged in a high risk lifestyle. Despite her challenges, Ms. Henry kept in frequent contact with her family. She was last seen on June 25, 1997, and was reported missing two days later.

Case reference: 2006008399.CaseDesc: Joseph Niro last contacted his daughter by telephone on June 02, 1999. He was last seen on June 20, 1999.

Hair: Black, Long, Wavy, Parted to the right

Case reference: 2014005223.CaseDesc: On March 4th, 2009, Wesley Foulds , 52, left his Abbotsford residence for an appointment in New Westminster.  Mr. Foulds didn't arrive for his appointment, and didn't show up for work later that day.  Mr. Foulds' vehicle was discovered the next day parked near the Hayward Dam in Mission BC.

Case reference: 2014003366.CaseDesc: John Groves was reported missing on July 8, 1981 from North West River, Newfoundland & Labrador.  The Happy Valley-Goose Bay RCMP were notified of an unoccupied aluminum boat with an outboard motor going in circles in Sheshatshiu, Labrador.  The investigation determined that the boat had been occupied by John Groves and it appears that he had fallen overboard and drowning was suspected. John's body has not yet been located.

Case reference: 2016069642.CaseDesc: On April 21, 1995, the remains of a woman were discovered near Carbon, Alberta. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 10 and 15 years. The individual had dental restorations including stainless steel crowns.

Case reference: 2014004419.CaseDesc: Holly Painter was initially reported as a missing person on June 26, 1995. On that evening, two friends of Holly's reported that they were at her residence when an argument broke out between Holly and one of the friends. They said that Holly assaulted that friend; the other friend then took Holly from the residence. All 3 of them left in the second friend's vehicle, with him driving. He reported that he intended to take Holly to her parents' residence, however, while making a left turn at an intersection, she jumped out of the vehicle and ran off.

Case reference: 2006003399.CaseDesc: On November 2, 2001, this male, was found in a sewer at 470 Lansdowne Avenue in Toronto. His ancestry is Caucasian, possibly Egyptian or mixed African/Caucasian. He had previous surgery of his left forearm, which had involved the implant of surgical plates. The numbers visible on the surgical plates could not be traced to a specific individual, however, it was determined that the lot was released some time after May 25, 1994. A MacDonald’s name tag with the name "Raymond" was found in the sewer, which may or may not be related to this individual.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Teeth were stained, which suggests he may have been a smoker,  his upper central incisors were also missing
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Hip, recent fracture of left hip

Case reference: 2025015368.CaseDesc: On July 30, 1966, the body of a burned man was found north of 18th street in Val-d'Or, Abitibi, Quebec.  A lighter was found near the body and a metal belt buckle was associated with the body.

Leggings: Lighter, found next to belt buckle

Case reference: 2005002599.CaseDesc: On October 21, 1989, an unidentified man was discovered in the area of County Road 14 in Napanee, Ontario.  Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts that this man was of south Asian ancestry.

Shirt: White, Brand: Pierre Cardin; grey, blue, and red thin stripes

Case reference: 2014003894.CaseDesc: Jean Gravel and Jean-Guy Champagne were employees of the Rio Bar in downtown Trois-Rivières, Quebec. On July 6, 1972, the pair arrived at work in the early evening and they were to work there until closing. They never returned home and have not been seen since, Jean and Jean-Guy were reported missing on July 10, 1972.

Jewelry: Silver, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, wedding ring on the left ring finger
Gold, Gold, ring on the left ring finger

Case reference: 2006017399.CaseDesc: On February 15, 1978, Mary Frances Gregory left her home in Parry Sound, Ontario, Canada, for a vacation in California, USA. She never arrived in Palo Alto and has had no contact with her family or friends since.  It is believed that Mary left Canada in a motor vehicle with a male acquaintance, who claims to have dropped her off at a bus station in Las Vegas, Nevada, around ten days after leaving Canada.  The driver claims to have travelled to Nevada via the US states of New York, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Illinois, Colorado, Utah and Arizona.

Mark: Right Abdomen, Brown, in shape of 5 cent piece (10mm)

Case reference: 2025032880.CaseDesc: On April 29, 2025, a man was found unresponsive outside the Walmer TTC station building in Toronto, Ontario.

InfoSection: Plastic, Black, Plastic hair tie with duct tape

Case reference: 2014005457.CaseDesc: On July 7, 2010, Roosdianajati and Didik Harijanto were seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Roosdianajati and Didik were scheduled to work, but did not show up for their shifts.

Case reference: 2023062205.CaseDesc: Kevin Hipfner was last seen on November 10, 2023 in rural Barrhead, Alberta. Kevin left home in his father's vehicle.  The vehicle was later found near a local lake, but to date, Kevin has not been located.

Case reference: 2005000899.CaseDesc: On April 21, 2005, a Caucasian male, believed to be between the ages of 29 and 50, was found in a wooded area on the embankment of a small creek off Queen Street in Bobcaygeon, Ontario. There are indications that this person suffered from early age-related osteoarthritis. It is believed that this individual had likely been at this location since 1994 or earlier.

Case reference: 2006009199.CaseDesc: On July 09, 2003, Michael Linklater, his father and brother went to the Linklater family hunting & fishing camp; located near mile marker 115 on ONR Railroad line, between Cochrane and Moosonee. Michael left the camp at about 6:00 p.m. on July 12, 2003, and has not been seen since. His father and brother searched for hours before going to mile marker 126 and calling the police. An extensive search in the area has failed to locate him.

Case reference: 2012020658.CaseDesc: On November 13, 1993, Joyce Tillotson was last seen in Regina, Saskatchewan, when she left her residence to visit a friend. She never arrived at her friend’s home. Joyce was originally from the Carry The Kettle First Nation near Indian Head in Saskatchewan.

Scar: Left Elbow, Burn injury; above the elbow
Right Wrist, Two on the back of the wrist
Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Initials "TR" on the bicep
Right Elbow, Text "Terry S"; inside of elbow

Case reference: 2005001799.CaseDesc: On June 1, 1975, the body of an older adult female was located on the west bank of the Niagara River, in the town of Niagara-on-the-Lake. She is believed to be the same person who was witnessed jumping into the Horseshoe Falls on February 17, 1975. She is thought to be 40 plus years, short and heavy-set, with brown hair. She suffered from lung disease and had severe arthritis of her lumbar spine, which may have been painful. When witnessed going over the Falls, she was wearing a long overcoat, possibly grey, and carrying a green umbrella. There is no confirmation that the jumper and the deceased are the same person, however the general descriptions are in agreement. The condition of her remains suggest that she had been in the water for weeks to months.

Teeth: This female probably had a partial dental plate and still retained a gold crown on her right upper canine tooth.

Case reference: 2018039302.CaseDesc: On February 17, 1992, at approximately 9:00 am, Glenn Levy was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Prior to his disappearance, Glenn had attempted to travel by bus to visit his father in Florida, USA.

Coat: Nylon, Black, Parka, green trim, 3/4 length

Case reference: 2012020142.CaseDesc: On September 10, 2008, Shannon Alexander, 17 and Maisy Odjick, 16, were reported missing from the First Nation community of Kitigan Zibi in Quebec. This community is located near the town of Maniwaki. On September 5, 2008, the two girls went to the Maniwaki arena, where several young people were present. Maisy then went to spend the night at Shannon’s house. Shannon’s father was the last person to have seen his daughter on September 6, 2008. In 2015 an age progression was done for both Maisy and Shannon.

Pierce: Mouth, 2 loops on the lower lip

Case reference: 2014002572.CaseDesc: André Demange was last seen on September 2, 1983, in Montreal, Quebec. André's personal effects were found a few days later near the water close to Des Ormeaux and Bellerive street.

Case reference: 2014001029.CaseDesc: On February 11, 1992, the body of this man was discovered on a beach in the vicinity of Hesquiat, located on the west coast of Vancouver Island, British Columbia. He had sustained a previous injury to his right knee, which had resulted in arthritis, and he was likely to have originated from the United States.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Knee, Compression fracture of the right proximal tibia, accompanied by arthritis

Case reference: 2014006175.CaseDesc: On July 8, 2013, at approximately 5:30 a.m., Jason Bathily and his twin sister, Clarene Bathily, were seen for the last time with their mother, Adelyne Mounga, in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004857.CaseDesc: On September 21, 1992, David Neufeld, Peter Bentzen and Kenneth Vaughan were seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. The three men had been associating with each other as “runners” in order to smuggle cigarettes into Canada from the United States by means of a boat. David’s vehicle and boat trailer were located at Ashbridges Bay, Toronto. The aging boat that was borrowed from a friend has never been recovered and the three men have not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014002896.CaseDesc: On October 25, 1981, at around 10:00 p.m., Madeleine Thibault was seen for the last time on Commerciale Road in Lévis, Québec. While leaving her house, Madeleine mentioned that she was going to her mother's for a visit.

Case reference: 2014002936.CaseDesc: On February 3, 1988, David Ambroise, then 3 years old, was playing near the Saint-Maurice River in the First Nations reserve of Wemotaci, Quebec. David approached too close to the water, slipped and fell in. He was then swept away by the current, and has never been found despite searches.

Case reference: 2014003272.CaseDesc: On December 30, 1967 Michael Smith left his North Vancouver residence. Mr. Smith had been despondent over a friend’s death and has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2006010799.CaseDesc: On July 23, 1979, Keith Cromwell was last seen as he departed from Quarry Island/Lake of the Woods, near Kenora, Ontario, in a motor boat. Keith never arrived at his destination, Fog Island.

Case reference: 2014004453.CaseDesc: Samuel Samuelson was last seen on January 29, 2004, whilst riding a snowmobile by the lake at Île Bizard, near Deux Montagnes, in Montreal, Quebec. Case reference: 2014004758.CaseDesc: Brent Bassett was last seen in December 1987 and was living on his boat that had no engine at West Bay Marina in Esquimalt, British Columbia. Mr. Bassett  collected bottles from other people in the Marina for spending money and worked at the Salvation Army Thrift Store.

Case reference: 2018023712.CaseDesc: On May 1, 2018, Elsa Vargas was last seen near her home in Chateauguay, Quebec.  Elsa's vehicle remained parked in the driveway but nobody was home.  Elsa has citizenship in Costa Rica and speaks Spanish, French and English and her disappearance is contradictory to her usual behaviour.

Case reference: 2012020019.CaseDesc: Emerson Dobroskay, was last seen on October 28, 1988 at the Pit Pub located at the University of British Columbia. It is believed that Emerson may have fallen into a large pit dug for construction, but all searches have failed to locate him. Although foul play is not suspected, it cannot be ruled out.

Case reference: 2020036483.CaseDesc: Dorothy Cox was seen for the last time between the months of December 1942 and April 1943 in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2022065035.CaseDesc: On November 27, 2022, Alex Lawson was last seen on foot, leaving his Madeline Street apartment in Thunder Bay, Ontario.  Family have not heard from Alex since he was reported missing and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Scar: Abdomen, 8" wide from lower chest to pubic hair

Case reference: 2014003046.CaseDesc: Yu Lowe was last seen on February 15, 1984 when he left his home in Vancouver, British Columbia. Mr. Lowe said he was going to the movies and never came back.

Case reference: 2019072428.CaseDesc: In April of 2019, Corey Baldwin was seen for the last time in Ottawa, Ontario. It is out of character for Corey not to contact his father for an extended period of time. It is possible that Corey may be in British Columbia or Montreal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014004474.CaseDesc: On January 2, 1987, Lillian Kotyk was last seen when she left her home in Edmonton, Alberta. Lillian has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 1996004360.CaseDesc: Nina Akbarian may be accompanied by her father, Naser Akbarian. The last reported sighting of Nina was on July 11, 1996 in the city of Toronto, Ontario. Case reference: 2014005103.CaseDesc: On May 22, 2008, Mathieu Duguay was seen for the last time while shouting for help in Rivière-des-Prairies in Montreal, Quebec. Some of Mathieu’s personal belongings were found on the banks of the river, not far from where witnesses saw the young man disappear into the river currents. Extensive searches of the area were conducted, but he was never found.

Case reference: 2020013402.CaseDesc: On May 2, 2020, Vincent Turcotte was seen for the last time in the Parc des Berges area of Clermont, Quebec. The bike Vincent was riding was found near the Malbaie River.

Hair: Auburn, Short, Sports a moustache and a little beard
